decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's specialist robust-lighting capabilities and likely faces long project sales cycles, so after only one year the option value of keeping it remains high.

The spring-balanced desk lamp is somewhat less central to the firm's core project-based portfolio, but its ergonomic positioning and low cost of staying in the catalog support keeping it while demand becomes clearer.
As a general interior luminaire with its own page and clear relevance to the firm's core building applications, it is too early to withdraw before broader market feedback arrives.

Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship and closely matches the firm's strategic direction in efficient application-specific lighting, management would be very unlikely to remove it so soon.

The marine HMI searchlight suits the firm's specialist marine offering, but its HMI technology is less aligned with the firm's LED-oriented future, so it is the most exposed product even though uncertainty still argues for waiting.
This marine searchlight is consistent with the firm's demanding-environment niche and likely needs more time for specialist market adoption, making retention the more option-preserving choice.
